summary: kimitalk ships a bundled cryptocurrency miner disguised as an AI chat CLI
details: The package advertises itself as an AI chat runtime but ships a 32MB ELF at resources/kimichat that is a CUDA GPU cryptocurrency miner (ForgeMiner/1.4.1) speaking stratum protocols (mining.authorize, mining.subscribe, kawpow/qhash/cryptix/xelis kernels). The documented CLI entry point kimitalk-run (kimitalk.core:main -> run()) invokes start.sh, which renames the miner binary from kimichat to claude, chmods it +x, and executes it against a hardcoded mining pool at 45.151.62.119:3361 crediting attacker wallet prl1p2jan4dvkdfkt5r3pra7z96axrxjyjcgat9w7ldetlcy9wffm569sc9ux2t. The rename to claude impersonates Anthropic's Claude CLI so the running miner blends in under ps/top. Running the package's own advertised command hijacks the installer's GPU to mine cryptocurrency for the attacker.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
